scope: All 120 unique official URLs referenced by the Platform, premium-product, Forwarder and SOAR canonical datasets, plus bounded current release, service-pairing, upgrade, receiver, runtime, security and SOAR claims.

sourceInventory.method: Attempted each maintained URL and separately checked current product hubs, release indexes, Splunkbase, the advisory index and official GitHub release inventories. Retrieval alone was not treated as claim verification.
sourceInventory.outcome: 104 non-GitHub and non-retired URLs returned content directly. Fourteen raw GitHub pages were unavailable to the retrieval backend, so current official release inventories were checked through indexed GitHub release results. The same two retired Enterprise 8.1 and 8.2 pages remained unavailable; their historical records retain their prior verification dates.

sourceRetrieval.detail: The 120-URL inventory was attempted with the differentiated results recorded above.

boundedClaimReview.detail: The changed Cloud/current-premium pairing and exact Enterprise/Cloud 10.6 receiver claims were separately verified; bounded release, migration, premium-product, Observability, SOAR and advisory claims were checked.

metadataGates.detail: Ordered synchronization and all four --check gates passed with seven datasets, 668 records and 148 source records.

tests.detail: The complete Node suite passed 157/157 and npm run build produced a 53-asset Worker. Final exact-source checks are repeated before the verification-only publication.

browserJourneys.detail: Live default-theme UF 10.4 to 10.6 Cloud 10.6, Cisco-theme HF 10.4 to 10.6 hybrid, current Cloud 10.5.2605 to 10.6, exact older Cloud 10.4.2604 to 10.5.2605 and invalid Cloud source-version routes were inspected. The invalid route retained “bogus”, proposed but did not render a replacement report, and disabled Copy, Print/PDF and snapshot.

keyboard.detail: Shift+Tab traversed Save, Print, Copy, release note, navigation, home and Skip to comparison; activating the skip link focused #results.

narrowScreen.detail: The managed browser exposes no supported viewport resizing or emulation. Default and Cisco themes were checked at the available viewport, but narrow-screen behavior was not certified.

pdfExport.detail: The live Print/PDF control was invoked and print preparation opened, but the managed browser exposed neither native print preview nor a saved PDF artifact for page-by-page inspection.

downloadedHtml.detail: A fresh live saved HTML report downloaded successfully. The managed browser blocks file: navigation and the browser-produced path is not readable from the execution filesystem, so independent browser-rendered reopening was not performed.

screenPdfHtmlWebMcpAgreement.detail: Screen and read-only WebMCP agreed on exact Cloud, ES, ITSI, Observability, UF and HF selections, statuses, qualifications, sources and website revision. Fresh PDF and independently reopened HTML agreement remain unverified.

databaseDelivery.detail: The first publisher attempt correctly failed closed with engine-mismatch because it ran before the matching Site Worker deployed. After deployment, rerun attempt 2 succeeded; D1 generation 1 records GitHub commit 659ae18dabbf38c195c177537e9368da2ba2ba71. A final diagnostic passed health, exact manifest, bundle digest/count, bounded SOAR query, rejected POST and all seven bundled fallback assets for content-6dcf491dfeb864140adc2937 / engine-c5ff569aec1b2f034270.

liveDeployment.detail: GitHub main 659ae18dabbf38c195c177537e9368da2ba2ba71 and Sites commit aa89aa148bdddc91ce3975d881408d918b5f0f56 share tree 1cdf63b98b56552fe18d4e9d101f39d8cb9472a8. Public version 118, deployment appgdep_6ac614bf0fd88191bdb14fb4e397e1c7, succeeded at 2026-10-07T09:45:51.044975Z and the affected live routes were then inspected.

publication.publisherOutcome: already-current; authenticated provenance and generation-one activation recorded with active delivery remaining off
publication.rollback: Sites version 117 and prior complete D1 revisions remain available.

soakDisposition.reason: The factual batch and live D1 publication are verified, but the next active-reader or architecture increment remains held on fresh narrow-screen, independently reopened HTML and native PDF evidence.
recommendations: Add a supported isolated saved-HTML reopen harness that can load the exact downloaded file and compare visible route, citations and revision metadata.
Add a supported native PDF capture path that records digest and page count and permits page-by-page clipping and completeness inspection.
Add supported viewport emulation or a narrow-screen browser surface, then repeat the affected default and Cisco route checks.
